title: The result stands there
line: A beehive: jars of honey filling at its foot, the bees calm behind glass, one quiet sentence.

title: Wanted before it is built
line: A product maker presses a drawn table; its top rises like a lift and swallows a drawn cup.

title: One clean movement
line: A potter pushes a pale vase into red glaze until it stands exactly level with the rim.

title: The odd raw material
line: A small candle maker tears a glass-clear slab; the label says it will be an iced coffee.

title: What is under the paint?
line: A furniture restorer finds a black table in the trash and asks one exact question.
